name: Поліпшення позиції фігури (2)
description:
After all your pieces have been developed, you move on to optimization. In the middle game you can constantly ask yourself: which piece can I improve? Compare the activity of all your pieces and look for a piece that could receive a new task.

What do you have to do?

Improve a piece by moving it to a more active square.

examples.text: With the precise 1.Qb3! White can target the black pawn on b7.
White wants to keep pieces on the board here. This can be done with the energetic 1.Nc5!. White makes it difficult for black to develop and white can continue with Re1 on the next move.

texts: The queen is great here. White can't defend the weak e-pawn well.
